b1-26-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Calling
b1-26-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she thinks about the work of a doctor. You (Meg) say that a good doctor considers the work a calling and that a doctor is well-versed in the profession.
b1-26-01.prompt: Tell Petra how a good doctor sees the work and what the doctor knows well.
cues: Say how a good doctor sees the work
Say that the doctor is well-versed in the profession
b1-26-01.target: A jó orvos hivatásának tekinti a munkáját. Jártas a szakmában.
b1-26-01.english: A good doctor considers his work his calling. He is well-versed in the profession.
b1-26-01.canDo: I can say that I consider my work a calling, with hivatásának tekinti.

b1-26-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Too Much Overtime
b1-26-02.scenario: Károly says that he has worked a lot of overtime lately and feels tired. You (Meg) say that he must not overdo work and that he has to set aside time for rest.
b1-26-02.prompt: Tell Károly what he must not do and what he has to make time for.
cues: Say that he must not overdo work
Say that he has to set aside time for rest
b1-26-02.target: Nem szabad túlzásba vinned a munkát. Időt kell szánnod a pihenésre.
b1-26-02.english: You must not overdo work. You have to set aside time for rest.
b1-26-02.canDo: I can say that I must not overdo work and that I set aside time for rest, with túlzásba visz and időt szán.

b1-26-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Work and Family
b1-26-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg how she manages her work and her family. You (Meg) say that you create a balance between work and family and that urgent work takes priority.
b1-26-03.prompt: Tell Károly how you manage work and family.
cues: Say that you create balance between work and family
b1-26-03.target: Megteremtem az egyensúlyt a munka és a család között. A sürgős munka prioritást élvez.
b1-26-03.english: I create a balance between work and family. Urgent work takes priority.
b1-26-03.canDo: I can say that I create balance between work and family, with megteremti az egyensúlyt.

b1-26-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Recognition at Work
b1-26-04.scenario: Petra asks Meg what happened to a colleague at the end of the year. You (Meg) say that the colleague strives for promotion and that the team received recognition.
b1-26-04.prompt: Tell Petra what your colleague wants and what the team got.
cues: Say what your colleague strives for
b1-26-04.target: A kollégám az előléptetésre törekszik. A csapat elismerésben részesült.
b1-26-04.english: My colleague is striving for promotion. The team received recognition.
b1-26-04.canDo: I can say that I strive for promotion and receive recognition, with törekszik and elismerésben részesül.

b1-26-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Good Atmosphere
b1-26-05.scenario: Károly asks Meg why she likes her workplace. You (Meg) say that you find joy in your work and that a pleasant atmosphere matters to everyone.
b1-26-05.prompt: Tell Károly why you like your workplace.
cues: Say that you find joy in your work
Say what is important for everyone
b1-26-05.target: Örömömet lelem a munkámban. A kellemes munkahelyi légkör mindenkinek fontos.
b1-26-05.english: I find joy in my work. A pleasant workplace atmosphere is important for everyone.
b1-26-05.canDo: I can say that I find joy in my work and stay faithful to my values, with örömét leli and hű marad.

b1-26-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Édes Anna
b1-26-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about Édes Anna is about. You (Meg) say that Vizyné shows her flat to her guests and that Moviszter doktor says that a person is not a machine.
b1-26-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what Vizyné does and what Moviszter doktor says.
cues: Say what Vizyné shows her guests
Say what the doctor says about people
b1-26-consolidation.target: Vizyné a vendégeinek mutatja a lakását. Moviszter doktor azt mondja, hogy az ember nem gép.
b1-26-consolidation.english: Vizyné shows her flat to her guests. Doktor Moviszter says that a person is not a machine.
b1-26-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a maid and her employers in a few sentences.
